Post-merge follow-up #1 RESOLVED 2026-08-02 (AD-1): implicit-SQ promotion peek-FREE by eager parity
nodes.rationale: Code inspection inverted the original premise ('move the peek into decodeCore'): the eager reference never promoted defined-length dictionary-miss elements (_readTag's length rule promotes only undefined lengths); the two event-stream sources INVENTED the promotion. Fix: deleted fromPart10's el.items trust and fromPart10Stream's defined-length FFFE peek; restricted the parser's isSequence() peek to undefined-length elements (also fixing throws on defined-length values resembling item/delimiter tags); resolveVrInstance documented as the single canonical implicit-VR contract. Pinned by the fromPart10Stream.test.js 'AD-1' suite (all four read paths) plus decodeCore unit tests.

nodes.label: Post-merge follow-up #3 RESOLVED 2026-08-02 (ED-1): Gate 5b deflate relay throttle
nodes.rationale: Gate 5b exposed the relay balloon for real: 856 compressed bytes ballooned to 103,600 retained bytes. The deflate relay now throttles on bodyStream retention with a demand-aware deadlock guard (128-byte sub-slice pushes, 16 KiB high water). Helper extraction (compareTrees/DicomWriter to test/eventStream/helpers/) remains open as ED-4.
